inlineSql: SELECT B.IT_NAME FROM (SL_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = '025' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND C.BOOK_TYPE = 'T' AND (B.HSN_CODE = '' OR B.HSN_CODE IS NULL) GROUP BY B.IT_NAME

SELECT A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_GSTNO,B.AC_PIN FROM (SL_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = '025' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND C.BOOK_TYPE = 'T' AND (B.AC_PIN = '' OR B.AC_GSTNO = '') GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_GSTNO,B.AC_PIN

SELECT A.CO_BOOK,E.MAIN_BOOK,E.BOOK_SR_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,C.AC_GSTNO,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_STATE,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_ADD2,C.AC_CITY,C.AC_PIN,C.AC_MOBILE,C.AC_EMAIL, A.NET_AMT,A.SGST_TAX,A.CGST_TAX,A.IGST_TAX,A.DISC_AMT,A.TOT_AMT FROM (SL_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = E.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = '025' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND E.BOOK_TYPE = 'T' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO
